## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile/tablet-friendly 2D card game themed around Dandy World, Hazbin Hotel, and Helluva Boss.

## Requirements
- Include character cards with types, attacks, retreat costs, weaknesses, artwork, basic/evolution forms, and skins.
- Include lobby formats (ranked, standard, expanded, average expanded, unrestricted), game modes (gold cards, jumbo, union), shop packs/boxes, collection, and deck builder.
- Support decks up to 150 cards, with a 60-card battle deck and separate life, wish, blessing, curse, gamble, and revive card sections.
- Build now without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Assumed an original 12-character starter roster with stylized emoji-based card art and original stats.
- Used a self-contained browser implementation with localStorage saves; match play is a simple turn-based battle.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial browser game UI and gameplay in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Implemented lobby, card collection/search/filter, shop and pack opening, deck creation/editing, evolution, and battle actions.
- Added local persistence, gold rewards, and responsive mobile navigation.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Browser-check the running game, capture a small JPEG, and fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli` and inspect the lobby and console.
2. Exercise collection, pack opening, deck builder, and battle interactions; fix discovered issues.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: App shell and navigation.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and card/UI styles.
- `game.js`: Card data, saved state, rendering, and game interactions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The current starter deck contains 60 cards; game is a prototype, not a full online/multiplayer rules implementation.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile/tablet-friendly 2D card game themed around Dandy World, Hazbin Hotel, and Helluva Boss.

## Requirements
- Include character cards with types, attacks, retreat costs, weaknesses, artwork, basic/evolution forms, and skins.
- Include lobby formats (ranked, standard, expanded, average expanded, unrestricted), game modes (gold cards, jumbo, union), shop packs/boxes, collection, and deck builder.
- Support decks up to 150 cards, with a 60-card battle deck and separate life, wish, blessing, curse, gamble, and revive card sections.
- Build now without asking clarifying questions.

- Use an original 12-character starter roster with emoji-based card art and original stats.
- Implement as a self-contained browser game with localStorage saves and simple turn-based battles.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile/tablet-friendly 2D card game themed around Dandy World, Hazbin Hotel, and Helluva Boss.

## Requirements
- Include character cards with types, attacks, retreat costs, weaknesses, artwork, basic/evolution forms, and skins.
- Include lobby formats (ranked, standard, expanded, average expanded, unrestricted), game modes (gold cards, jumbo, union), shop packs/boxes, collection, and deck builder.
- Support decks up to 150 cards, with a 60-character battle deck and separate life, wish, blessing, curse, gamble, and revive cards.
- Build now without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use an original 12-character starter roster with emoji-based card art and original stats.
- Implement a self-contained browser game with localStorage saves and simple turn-based battles.
- Set clean-install starter inventory to five copies of each character, giving the starter deck 60 character cards.
